title: Free career test: Holland code (RIASEC) interest test — cv.cm
description: Free career aptitude test based on Holland's RIASEC model. Rate 36 activities to get your three-letter Holland code and careers that fit your interests. No sign-up.
lede: Find careers that fit your interests. Rate 36 activities and get your three-letter Holland code, from Realistic, Investigative, Artistic, Social, Enterprising and Conventional.
about: Psychologist John Holland found that people and work environments can be described by six interest types, known as RIASEC. People tend to be more satisfied in jobs that match their top types.

Your Holland code is your top three letters in order. Use it to explore careers: the U.S. O*NET database, for example, lists occupations by Holland code. This test was written for cv.cm and measures interests, not ability.

faq.a: Your three strongest interest types, in order, such as SAE or RIC. It is used by career counselors to suggest fitting jobs and fields of study.

faq.q: Should I rate activities I have never tried?
faq.a: Yes. Imagine doing the activity and rate how much you would enjoy it, not how good you would be at it.
No. It measures interest. Skills can be learned; interest predicts which work you will enjoy long enough to get good at.

faq.q: My scores are almost equal. What now?
faq.a: A flat profile means broad interests. Look at careers that combine your top types, and try short projects to see what you enjoy.

R.name: Realistic (doer)
R.body: You like practical, hands-on work with tools, machines, plants or animals, and visible results. Careers to explore: electrician, mechanic, engineer, chef, carpenter, farmer, pilot, physiotherapist.

I.name: Investigative (thinker)
I.body: You like to observe, analyze and solve complex problems. Careers to explore: scientist, software developer, data analyst, doctor, pharmacist, researcher, economist.

A.name: Artistic (creator)
A.body: You like to create and express yourself in unstructured settings. Careers to explore: designer, writer, musician, photographer, architect, video editor, art director.

S.name: Social (helper)
S.body: You like to help, teach and care for people. Careers to explore: teacher, nurse, counselor, social worker, HR specialist, coach, therapist.

E.name: Enterprising (persuader)
E.body: You like to lead, persuade and take risks to reach goals. Careers to explore: entrepreneur, sales manager, marketer, lawyer, real estate agent, product manager.

C.name: Conventional (organizer)
C.body: You like order, accuracy and clear procedures with data. Careers to explore: accountant, auditor, administrator, logistics coordinator, bank officer, database administrator.
